title: NPDev resolved host plan
description: GENERATED, never hand-edited. Written to _ops/host-plan.json on every generation by HostPlanEmitter: the authored host.definition.json merged with resolved facts from the compiled model and _ops/resolved-db-plan.json. Analogue of resolved-db-plan.json. Every hosting artifact and `npdev host check` reads this and nothing else.

generatedAt.description: OMIT unless the determinism checker is taught to exclude this file. check-deterministic-generation.ps1 SHA-256s every emitted file across two runs; a timestamp fails it.

portFromEnv.description: PORT on Render/Koyeb/Fly, SERVER_PORT elsewhere. See task P1.

engine.description: Copied from resolved-db-plan.json. BAKED IN AT GENERATION TIME -- not switchable by env var.

terminatesTlsElsewhere.description: True for every kind but 'nobody'. When true, forward-headers-strategy is mandatory -- see check `forwarded-headers`.

springProfiles.description: e.g. 'prod,postgres'. BOTH halves or StartupValidator refuses to boot, naming the missing one.

requiredEnv.description: The complete environment contract for this plan. Pinned across four seams by twin-pair rule host-plan-required-env-seams.

value.description: Null means the operator must supply it.

source.description: 'npdev' = resolved by the platform. 'you' = a secret only the operator has.

why.description: One sentence: what breaks if this is wrong.
